description: Checks the email setup of any domain: SPF (one record, ending, the 10 DNS lookup limit), DKIM on the common selectors (or dkim_selector), DMARC policy and reports, MX and mailbox provider, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. Answers a 0 to 100 score, a grade, the fix for each problem in plain words and records ready to copy. Free, read only. / Confere SPF, DKIM, DMARC e MX de qualquer domínio, com nota e a correção de cada problema.

dkim_selector.description: A DKIM selector to look up besides the common ones (the s= of the DKIM-Signature header)

domain.description: e.g. "example.com" (a URL or an address also works)

name: check_domain_dns
title: Check a domain's email DNS / Verificar SPF, DKIM e DMARC
